name: Bitcoin

description: Ethereum is a decentralized platform for smart contracts and decentralized applications (DApps).

name: Ripple
description: Ripple is a real-time gross settlement system, currency exchange and remittance network.

name: Solana
description: Solana is a high-performance blockchain supporting smart contracts and decentralized apps.

name: Dogecoin
description: Dogecoin started as a meme cryptocurrency, now used for tipping and microtransactions.

name: Polkadot

name: Polygon
description: Polygon is a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum with low-cost transactions.

name: Litecoin

name: Avalanche

name: Uniswap

name: Chainlink

name: Algorand
description: Algorand is a scalable, secure blockchain with immediate transaction finality.

name: VeChain
description: VeChain is a blockchain platform focused on supply chain and business process management.

name: Filecoin

name: Internet Computer
description: Internet Computer is a blockchain aiming to run the entire internet as a decentralized computer.

name: TRON
description: TRON is a blockchain-based OS for content sharing and decentralized apps.

name: Cosmos
description: Cosmos is a network of interoperable blockchains for secure data and token transfer.

name: Stellar
description: Stellar is a blockchain for fast cross-border payments and token issuance.
